snippet.title: ECC: REDLINE | Official Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Get your first look at ECC: REDLINE gameplay, where extreme sports and tactical survival collide.

Sprint, slide, aim, and fire in one seamless flow. Combine tactical abilities with your squad, earn in-match credits, and upgrade your gear on the spot.

All footage was captured in-game from a PC build in development and does not represent final game quality.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268340/ECC_REDLINE/

#ECCREDLINE #ECC

Follow the official channels for more updates:
